name: psynex
tagline: Psynex is documentation software for psychotherapists
description: Psynex is documentation software for psychotherapists. Record a session on any device, and Psynex transcribes it and drafts a structured clinical note: summary, session content, progress over time. You edit, approve and export. Everything runs on EU infrastructure. Each user's data is encrypted with their own key, and a data processing agreement is available.
